kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَجِسْتَان or سِجِسْتَان • (sajistān or sijistān) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Old Persian *Sakastānah
Middle Persian 𐭮𐭪𐭮𐭲𐭠𐭭 (skstʾn /⁠Sagestān⁠/)bor.
Arabic سجستان
Borrowed from Middle Persian 𐭮𐭪𐭮𐭲𐭠𐭭 (skstʾn /⁠Sagestān⁠/), from Old Persian *Sakastānah. Doublet of سِيسْتَان (sīstān).
g: Sajistan, a region of the eastern Iranian Plateau now known as Sistan.
